text:
jin: FYI ops wants to deprecate the legacy envelope (`body.envelope.payload`) on 2024-10-01. My quick mitigation idea: deploy a short-lived edge "shape-adapter" that unwraps legacy envelopes to our canonical v2 shape for a configurable grace window. Per-tenant opt-in via feature flag. Thoughts?
pat: Main constraints: streaming & websockets. We must not mutate stream frames mid-flight. Adapter should only act on full POSTs, not on Upgrade/ws flows. Otherwise we'll break partial-consume clients.
jin: Yep. For WS/streaming, adapter returns a clear 426 with migration hint if the old shape is used; we won't attempt mid-stream fixes.
evie: Cache implications: if we rewrite requests we could change cache_key composition. We need to compute the canonical cache key before rewriting and inject it (X-Canonical-Cache-Key) so downstream caches use the same key. Publish the canonical serializer.
pat: Also session prefix cache keys differ by shape. Suggest dual-write alias for prefix keys for 7 days post-translation to avoid cold misses, then GC. Make GC a scheduled job.
jin: Rollout sketch: deploy shape-adapter behind tenant flag; canary 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% for opted-in tenants. Non-opted tenants get deprecation header but passthrough. Auto-translate window: opt-ins get 60d auto-translate, non-opt-ins get 30d notice then 90d full cutoff.
evie: Observability: metrics: shape_translated_total, shape_translate_errors, translate_latency_ms{p50,p95}, cache_hit_rate_delta. Add an alert if translate_errors_rate > 0.5% or p95 delta > 20ms.
pat: Failure semantics: small mapping fixes (deprecated field synonyms, quote/whitespace) -> auto-fix. Structural mismatches (missing required fields, ambiguous arrays) -> 400 with migration advice and a header X-Shape-Translated:false. Also add X-Deprecation: envelope-2024-10-01.
jin: Also include X-Compat-Translated:true for successful translations so customers can correlate. We'll include X-Translation-Version too for debugging.
evie: Logging: sample raw payload dumps at 0.1% per tenant (opt-in toggle in Console) with PII scrubbing (emails, API keys, long tokens). Keep dumps encrypted and retention-limited.
ops-bot: deploy-schedule: shape-adapter v0.1 -> staging at 1778884000; tests: translation_consistency, cache_key_preserve, ws_noop.
pat: SDKs: we should ship a minor bump that warns when client constructs legacy envelope and offer an automated migration helper. Also provide canonical serializer reference to avoid cache mismatch.
jin: Implementation options: (A) edge lua rewrite (fast, rollbackable via FF), (B) sidecar translator service (extra hop, richer logs), (C) in-service library (requires coordinated releases). I'm leaning A for fastest iteration.
evie: Edge CPU cost: earlier prototypes added ~3-10ms depending on payload complexity. We should add headroom to edge autoscaling and measure p95 before enabling broadly.
pat: Rate-limiting behavior: if older clients flood due to repeated 400s, adapter should return 429 for abusive patterns and include clear guidance in body/header to reduce retry storms.
jin: Backout plan: flip FF off, remove alias writes, revert headers. Schedule alias GC 14 days after full cutover. SRE playbook: detect translation mismatch via metric thresholds and revert per-tenant.
evie: Telemetry: attach translation_metadata to traces (translated=true|false, version, latency) so we can correlate regressions to adapter changes. Add a small Console card for translated_rate + errors.
pat: Security: do not persist full raw payloads by default. Only with tenant opt-in toggle. Scrub before writing. Use KMS for storage.
jin: I'll draft a short RFC with timeline, rollouts, and playbook and link this thread. Who wants to own SDK PR + docs?
docu: I can own docs + Console banner. Will draft migration snippets and quickstart changes.
jin: Thanks all  let's sync after the staging run tomorrow. :coffee:
